item.title: Your Best XI From the Weekend | EDP Cup Fall Showcase Girls 2025
item.description: EDP Soccer has announced the Best XI from the EDP Cup Fall Girls Showcase 2025 this past weekend. The selections were made based on the performance of the players during the tournament. Congratulations to the following players who were selected.

item.title: 2025 EDP Cup Fall Boys Showcase Spotlights Top Team Talent
item.description: The EDP Cup Fall Boys Showcase took center stage over the weekend, with over 200 teams competing at Tuckahoe Turf Farm in Hammonton, NJ. Teams were in attendance from seven states, including NJ, PA, NY, CT, MD DE, and FL. Brackets were comprised of teams from MLS NEXT, NAL, ECNL, and National League, creating highly competitive match up against diverse competition.

item.title: Seven States Competing, One Epic Weekend: 40 Champions Crowned at EDP Winter Classic
item.description: EDP Soccer concluded its 2025 tournament calendar over the weekend with the EDP Winter Classic. The event included over 230 teams, representing seven different states with 40 champions being crowned across 11U-19U boys and girls divisions.

item.title: EDP Soccer Partners with TeamMatch to Elevate Youth Athlete Development
item.description: EDP Soccer (EDP) is proud to partner with TeamMatch on the launch of their innovative sports-app platform. EDP Soccer recognizes the growing influence of technology in the world of youth sports and is excited to showcase the new TeamMatch SaaS product to its athletes via event signage and promotional offers throughout 2026.

item.title: Celebrating the Futsal State Cup Maryland 2026 Champions
item.description: The 2026 EDP Futsal State Cup Maryland concluded over the weekend, with seven teams being crowned champions. Top 9U-12U Boys and Girls teams competed in Catonsville, with Bethesda SC leading the way with the most state championships.

item.title: The First Phase of 2026 NJYS Futsal Championships was a Thriller
item.description: On Saturday, January 17, 2026, premier youth futsal teams from across the region gathered at Iron Peak Sports & Events to kick off the 2026 New Jersey Youth Soccer Futsal Championships. This annual winter event sits as one of the state’s most competitive indoor futsal tournaments, giving boys and girls squads from U14 through U19 the first opportunity of the weekend to compete for top honors in fast-paced, 5-a-side futsal action.

item.title: Quick Feet & Pure Passion at the 8U-13U NJYS Futsal Championships
item.description: This weekend saw U8-U13 Boys teams take the court at the New Jersey Youth Soccer Futsal Championships at Iron Peak Sports & Events in Hillsborough, NJ. Top futsal programs from around the region competed, with 10 top teams being crowned champions.

item.title: 2026 RAL Winter Fest FL Saw Teams Compete from Up & Down the East Coast
item.description: The RAL Winter Fest took place at the beautiful Jupiter Community Park, with teams from up and down the East Coast participating. Teams from Massachusetts, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Maryland and Florida all competed, as teams enjoyed highly competitive matches as they prepare for their Spring season

item.title: 2026 EDP Soccer Promising Young Coaches: Honoring Young Leaders Shaping the Future of Youth Soccer
item.description: EDP Soccer has announced its list of 30 Promising Young Coaches for 2026. Each of the coaches are under the age of 30 and represent clubs that compete in EDP Soccer Leagues.
